## Summary

- explain why this translation change exists
- mention whether the PR contains only new keys or also config changes

## Review Checklist

- [ ] suggested keys and namespaces are correct
- [ ] locale text is complete and intentional
- [ ] application scope is correct
- [ ] translation validation workflow is green

## Operational Rule

- existing key edits may go directly through the direct-update path on `main`
- new keys must be reviewed through this pull request flow before merge
